rationale: Independent review of the stock-take analysis specification current/ANALYSIS-SPEC-2.md (sha256 395c115aeb18d6219c2c1fa8c8a16bb0688ccdf3e2b64dec8a87abe1354b27d6, version 2) under run_id stocktake-c9deb31c7f8668b41df09ea8. Verified in this stage (observed facts): (1) Both binding lines are present and exact; analysis_registry_sha256 ade457dac0f154ea02a81d0cb405d0951ca4117be0f4a262505034076d07d1d6 matches the staged private index artifact, which exists at its hash-named path evidence/0a5553cd...-private-index.json with the declared 98435 bytes. (2) All 17 exact finding records in this workspace were read; the spec's registry claims match them byte-for-byte: S9-01 and S9-02 are closed with sources at spans 4477:6246 and 6248:8249 of the Sprint9 CNN review (sha c399c2aa...) and exact r4 closures at spans 1439:1759 and 1760:2190 of the r4 readiness review (sha bfb9b343...), whose disposition texts describe attributed extracted-code fixtures (identical partitions across ten shuffle/fold combinations; two-patient regeneration without calling train) exactly as the spec characterizes them; STEPD-run_spec_review-1 is closed by approval-run_spec_review-2 at span 0:4960 embedded in its finding record, with the original REVISE and its provenance reasoning preserved verbatim, and the spec correctly states that this closure neither erases the original judgment nor proves later execution succeeded; the remaining 14 records (S9-03, S9-04.1-.3, S10-R4-01..04, S9-R4-01..06) carry resolution null and the spec lists exactly these as open, asserting no blanket closure and not asserting persistence of every defect in later bytes; S9-R4-01 is confirmed to contain only the table-separator fragment '| --- | --- | --- |', and the spec's treatment of it as a register advisory rather than a scientific defect is accurate. (3) Scope and authority: the spec is analysis-only, proposes no training, notebook/helper execution, patient computation, model call, spending or successor dispatch, terminates in operator review, treats the selected T_pnorm_mtt/READY status as granting no locked access, keeps the Sprint10 per-model-intervals run receipt as a named gap rather than inspected evidence, keeps Sprint6 F_final explicitly NOT RUN against the misleading preceding 'stage complete' text, and preserves qualified AGENT_REVIEWED_NOT_HUMAN_RATIFIED and formal047b PAUSED dispositions at their original scopes. (4) Privacy: the text is aggregate-only with no patient identifiers; the three patient-level components used are named with their registered reasons and reported only as aggregates; withheld figures (maps_all_tree_models.png, maps_all_unet_models.png, maps_key_models.png, small_lesions_zoom.png, small_lesions_shadow.png, deck_maps_v2.zip, Sprint12 map exports) and missing alias/receipt/source files are listed as limitations without reconstruction, matching the operator decisions in current/figure-limitation-operator.txt and current/private-intake-operator-decision.txt; the 25 final-evaluation and 24 reserve patients are never scored, cited or touched. (5) Internal consistency checks pass: 17 findings enumerated; Sprint11 centres 67+31+1=99; size bins 28+50+20 plus one empty-truth case = 99; the Sprint3 49-recognized versus later 68-recorded treatment-grade discrepancy is explicitly framed as parser disagreement consistent with open finding S9-R4-03; F1 is defined; Sprint7 patient-clustered intervals are preferred over 297 pooled observations; the Sprint3b statistic error and its Sprint4 repair are cited; estimands (signed/absolute error, difference of medians versus median changes, patient means versus pooled voxels) are separated; exposure of all 99 development outcomes is disclosed and non-replication across Sprints 10/11/12/12b is stated. No blocker category is met: no test-set/leakage (development-99 only, locked cohorts untouched, exposure disclosed, every claim labeled exploratory); no code/spec mismatch in anything checkable here (every registry, closure, obligation and operator-decision correspondence verified exactly); no metric/statistic defect (definitions, denominators, clustering, rounding caveats and do-not-merge-endpoints rules are correct); no privacy/secret issue; no budget implication; no execution authority/provenance defect (nothing executes, no authority is claimed, evidence gaps are named as gaps). Honestly distinguished unavailable evidence, per the no-equating rule: this reviewer could not parse the single-line 98KB private index with the tools available in this stage and could not locate the 174 registered view files at any probed path, so the numeric table entries (Dice values, intervals, counts) remain attributed authoring-stage inspection bound to the hash-matched registry, explicitly NOT independently re-measured or re-inspected here; this is recorded as a reviewer-side evidence-access limitation, not treated as inspection and not a defect in the specification itself, and it arms no execution gate because the sole next step is operator review of the preserved record. Advisories (non-blocking): emit the private index pretty-printed or line-delimited so future independent reviews can open it and spot-check cited view components; the 12000-character cap and binding-line uniqueness were checked against the supplied packet text, not re-measured on disk; the carried open findings remain open and any later reliance on Sprint9/Sprint10 resumption, matched-amount loading, partition-dictionary checking or clinical parsing must cite their own exact closures first; known-case acceptance remains distinct from efficacy acceptance throughout. This APPROVE covers only this analysis-scope stock-take specification; it accepts no scientific conclusion as system-ratified, grants no successor, execution, locked-cohort or publication authority, and the work stops for operator review as specified.
